title: f32 narrowing, signed zero and literal spelling
teaches: Evaluation is f64 but every write is narrowed once to f32. A float spelling can preserve the sign of negative zero; the integer spelling -0 (and the unary expression that yields -0) must be read from the bits, not the decimal.
observe: 16777217 becomes 16777216: the f32 mantissa cannot carry the low bit.
The -0.0 key and the (- 0) expression write 0x80000000; the integer -0 key writes 0x00000000.
